El grafo pasa a ser un brain tal como es: The graph becomes a brain as it is: nothing in it is changed, nor in any other graph in the database.
Graphiti guardó estos datos con group_id: Graphiti stored this data with group_id {{ids}}. The brain reads it all the same, but what it learns later will be written with «{{graph}}» and will not be merged with it.
Lo que ya hay en la base de datos en uso: What the database in use already holds. A graph that is no brain's can be adopted as it is; one you do not adopt is never touched.
Se consulta y aprende: propuestas, inges: It is queried and it learns: proposals, ingestion and curation write to it.
Se consulta, pero nada lo escribe: ni pr: It is queried, but nothing writes to it: no proposals, no curation, no embedding model change.
Sus vectores no son los del motor de emb: Its vectors are not the embedding engine's
Tienen {{dim}} dimensiones y el motor po: They have {{dim}} dimensions and the default engine {{engine}}: similarity search would not compare them. It can be adopted read-only (facts, timeline and entities work); to adopt it as a full brain, first switch to an engine with {{dim}} dimensions.
Un grafo cuyo nombre lleva otros caracte: A graph whose name has characters other than letters, digits, - and _ cannot be adopted.
